name: Coinbase Commerce API
tagline: Accept crypto payments with hosted checkouts and webhooks
description: Coinbase Commerce is Coinbase's merchant crypto payment API for creating charges, checkout sessions, and invoices so businesses can accept cryptocurrency payments. Developers integrate via REST to create payment intents, track status, and receive webhook notifications for completed or failed payments. It is aimed at e-commerce and app checkouts rather than trading or exchange account APIs.

auth.details: API key via X-CC-Api-Key header; create keys in the Coinbase Commerce dashboard after merchant signup

use_cases: create a crypto payment charge for an order
verify a charge payment status by id
create a hosted checkout for crypto payment
